With over 12 years of experience, I now focus on sales development, marketing, market expansion, and supporting project management. What drives me every day are my children and a personal commitment to keep growing without giving up—always guided by one core value: honesty."},{"name":"JORGE MORA","image":"jorge","role":"Administration & Logistics Manager","bio":"As Administrative and Financial Manager, I bring 24 years of experience in the construction industry, including a decade in Canada. I’m deeply motivated by seeing the physical results of our efforts, and I especially enjoy when projects are successfully completed thanks to teamwork.

I consider myself a resilient leader, and each day I'm driven by the desire to leave a legacy my daughter and family can be proud of.
